records.checked_scope: The scalar quadratic endogenous-avoidance model and its ambient-health nonidentification example, extended to the complete positive-parameter equivalence family.
records.significance: A full parametrization proves that perfect ambient-health data can leave welfare effects without any finite upper bound, and gives exact bounds from avoidance-fraction information.
records.author: /root/new200_c

records.title: Sharp finite-horizon joint-kernel certificate by survival coupling
records.checked_scope: The uniform approximation theorem in the paragraph ‘A dynamic approximation guarantee’, restricted to identical costs (epsilon=0).
records.significance: A sharp nonquadratic error bound for finite rectangular models with identical costs, attained by a two-state absorbing construction.
records.author: /root/new200_c

records.title: Almost-sure compensability can coexist with infinite expected compensation near the ecological boundary
records.checked_scope: Essential-service CES preferences; random degraded services strictly above the deterministic critical threshold.
records.significance: Derives exact negative-moment criterion and sharp near-boundary tail exponent separating finite statewise transfers from an infinite expected compensation budget.
records.author: /root/new200_d

records.title: A fixed cheapest majority and an explicit water-filling durability frontier
records.checked_scope: Common-visibility, common-shock stationary rebate benchmark; exact coalition and tolerance computation.
records.significance: Shows top baseline tolerances always supply a cheapest majority and derives the complete piecewise-affine frontier with visibility-budget concavity.
records.author: /root/new200_d

records.title: Sharp finite-reform mobility gains from a local scarcity value and curvature bounds
records.checked_scope: Two-location quasilinear capacity benchmark with one binding upper bound and strongly concave aggregate surplus.
records.significance: Derives sharp saturating gain and rent bounds for finite capacity expansions using only a local shadow value and global curvature interval.
records.author: /root/new200_d

records.title: Minimax-regret scaling has an exact solution over all bounded-slope supply extensions
records.checked_scope: Full exact manuscript/YAML and independent result proved in report.
records.significance: Solves worst-case regret for scaling beyond pilot support over the full absolutely-continuous slope class, distinguishing it from worst-case welfare optimization.
records.author: /root/new200_b

records.title: Exact minimax-regret subsidy under the sharp spatial welfare interval
records.checked_scope: Policy choice under the source's identified agglomeration interval when national welfare is strictly concave in the subsidy.
records.significance: Solves minimax regret for the entire sharp identified welfare family, including boundary-constrained oracle policies and an explicit interior regret formula.
